description: Located right next to the Eiffel Tower, you will be immersed in the charm and elegance of Paris. In a building built in the 19th century.The apartment features spacious and comfortable rooms, tastefully furnished and equipped with all modern amenities such as flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi. Very bright and spacious apartments 2 BDR/ 2BTH/ 1 toilet. Fully equipped kitchen, living room and dining room. It is perfect for relaxing after a busy day exploring Paris !Other things to noteAs with many residential buildings in Paris, occasional renovation or maintenance work may take place elsewhere in the building or in neighboring properties during permitted daytime hours. This is outside of our control and is part of normal city life in Paris. We appreciate our guests’ understanding should any temporary noise occur during their stay.
